title: the Lower Danube Rising
author: Yara Winterbourne
blurb: Silas Ravensworth, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
